title: Charles and Drew's electrostatic thrust experiments: thrust continues after unplugging

plain: In experiments run by Charles Buhler and a colleague named Drew, devices meant to produce electrostatic thrust, a push made by electric charge without fuel, were tested in a shielded chamber in Buhler's lab. The claim is that you power the device up, unplug it from the wall, and the thrust "continues indefinitely." A researcher named David relays this claim, which also involves Buhler and a man named Tim Ventura, and he sounds wary as he tells it. If it held up, it would be a push with no power going in.
